message: hey, how's it going
just finished my homework, feeling good
excited for the weekend
had a pretty great day today
nothing much happening, just chilling
i can't stop overthinking about tomorrow's presentation
my hands are shaking, i think i'm gonna throw up before the exam
i keep checking my phone, something feels wrong
i'm so nervous i can't sit still
what if everyone hates me at the party tonight
i don't feel like doing anything anymore
everything feels pointless lately
i've been in bed all day, can't find the energy
i don't enjoy things like i used to
i feel numb most of the time
i have three deadlines this week and i'm losing it
so much on my plate right now, i can't keep up
work has been insane, i haven't had a break in days
i'm juggling too many things at once
feeling overwhelmed with everything on my to-do list
i was up all night full of energy and now i crashed hard
one day i feel unstoppable, the next i can't get out of bed
i spent way too much money last night, i wasn't thinking straight
my moods swing so fast it scares me
i barely slept but i don't even feel tired, just wired
i get so intense in relationships, i scare people away
one second i love them, the next i can't stand them
i don't even know who i am half the time
i overreact to everything and then hate myself for it
i feel empty unless someone's giving me attention
i don't want to be here anymore
i keep thinking everyone would be better off without me
i don't see the point in continuing
i've been thinking about ending things
i just want it all to stop
